Northwood High Staff

MRS. PERIWINKLE

The Dewey Decimal Terror & Master of Psychological Warfare.

  • Role: Head Librarian
  • Location: Northwood High
  • Domain: The Academic Wing
  • Specialty: Psychological Torture

While Mrs. DeMarco rules the physical space of the Commons with an iron fist, Mrs. Periwinkle governs the academic wing through absolute, uncompromising psychological warfare. Characterized by her perfectly coiffed gray hair, pastel cardigans, and an impossibly tight-lipped expression, the Head Librarian enforces a policy of absolute, uninterrupted silence.

The Demand for Order

She operates out of a highly structured library featuring endless rows of wooden bookshelves and a vintage 1999 desktop card catalog. Breaking her silence rule is one of the most severe tactical errors a student can make within the walls of Northwood High.

The Dewey Decimal Terror

Like Mrs. DeMarco, Mrs. Periwinkle offers an off-the-record rehabilitation program to save a student's permanent transcript from formal administrative marks. However, while DeMarco's justice is physical labor, Periwinkle's punishment is entirely mental. Offenders are forced to organize endless shelves of books in mathematically flawless Dewey Decimal order under her silent, unblinking supervision.

The Exchange Rate of Consequences

Her reputation for mind-numbing, meticulous torture is so severe that it actively alters student behavior. When faced with a choice, troublemakers like Josh Riley will actively beg to be sent to Northwood High's most exclusive after-school enrichment program—Advanced Sanitation Techniques (Trash Duty)—embracing the humiliating physical disgust of Mrs. DeMarco's grease traps rather than endure an afternoon of Mrs. Periwinkle's agonizing library categorization.

Engine Room Records (Real-World Imprint)

In real life, Engine Room Records (never “Engine Room Records, LLC”) is the creative brand and private record imprint under which Michael P. Ragsdale produces and distributes his music.
